mentions.name: Ambient idea capture device
mentions.description: Open, ambient device for capturing ideas hands-free while walking or running. Requires minimal user input: you dictate an idea, it gets transcribed, and the note is delivered wherever you want it to end up.
mentions.source_excerpt: - An ambient idea capture device. Open, ergonomic for walking/running, minimal user input required from dictation -> transcription wherever you want it to end up
